objects.description: Arbitrary-precision-like decimal number type for xrpl with 64-bit mantissa and integer exponent, supporting normalization, arithmetic, comparisons, rounding modes, and utility functions. Contains nested struct unchecked for constructing without normalization, an internal rounding_mode enum, and a private Guard forward declaration. Also provides helper classes saveNumberRoundMode and NumberRoundModeGuard to manage thread-local rounding mode. Details of normalize(), arithmetic operators, rounding implementation, and Guard are in the corresponding source file.
Tag type to request unchecked construction of xrpl::Number without normalization. Used to signal that provided mantissa and exponent are already normalized or that normalization should be skipped.

objects.definition: enum rounding_mode { to_nearest, towards_zero, downward, upward };
objects.description: Enumeration of rounding modes controlling Number conversions and arithmetic: round to nearest (ties to even), toward zero, toward −∞ (downward), toward +∞ (upward). Stored thread-locally via Number::mode_.

RAII helper that restores the previously active Number::rounding_mode on destruction. Construct with the current mode (typically the result of Number::setround) and it will set that mode back in its destructor.
RAII guard that sets a new Number::rounding_mode for the current scope and restores the previous mode upon destruction, implemented using saveNumberRoundMode and Number::setround.

Sentinel type used to enable efficient comparisons of user-defined numeric-like types to zero via signum-based operators. Also defines an internal anonymous-namespace constexpr instance `zero` for ADL-based comparisons.

functions.name: xrpl::Number::min
functions.description: Returns the smallest positive-magnitude normalized Number (with mantissa = minMantissa and exponent = minExponent).

functions.name: xrpl::Number::max
functions.description: Returns the largest normalized Number (with mantissa = maxMantissa and exponent = maxExponent).

functions.name: xrpl::Number::lowest
functions.description: Returns the lowest (most negative) normalized Number (the negation of max()).

functions.name: xrpl::Number::operator xrpl::Number::rep
functions.description: Explicit conversion to the underlying integer type (rep). Rounds to nearest, with ties to even.
requirements: Callers must use an explicit cast/static_cast to invoke this conversion.
Be aware of rounding: conversion rounds to nearest, ties to even (stated in comment).

functions.name: xrpl::root
functions.description: Computes the d-th root of f (i.e., f^(1/d)) using Newton–Raphson iterations until the result stops changing.

Convergence characteristics and domain restrictions (e.g., negative f for even d) are unspecified in this header (unknown).
